cadence_plan_operation.name: cadence_plan_operation
cadence_plan_operation.description: Plan explicit registered numeric values under the operator grant. Local only; no reservation or permission is created.

cadence_submit_operation.name: cadence_submit_operation
cadence_submit_operation.description: Submit one registered DC/AC/TRAN operation under confirmed operator scope and existing shared accounting. Same UUID retries only look up; never resend.

cadence_operation_status.name: cadence_operation_status
cadence_operation_status.description: Reconcile one admitted UUID and exact plan hash without dispatch or spend.

cadence_operation_result.name: cadence_operation_result
cadence_operation_result.description: Retrieve registered bounded measurements with terminal receipt, input, reader, frame and PSF integrity checks. Never reruns simulation or extraction.

cadence_cancel_pending_operation.name: cadence_cancel_pending_operation
cadence_cancel_pending_operation.description: Cancel only a verified pending or absent-intent operation with a durable remote tombstone. No active termination or reservation refund.

cadence_verify_change_readback.name: cadence_verify_change_readback
cadence_verify_change_readback.description: Compare typed parameter-change observations and an exact plan hash. Local evidence comparison only; artifact provenance requires independent verification.
